tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Lists the stored procedures in the Contoso Billing database. Use to find existing data access before writing new SQL. Read-only.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns the columns of one table (name, SQL Server type, NULL or NOT NULL). Use before writing SQL that reads or writes the table. Read-only; returns schema, never row data.

table.description: Table name, e.g. dbo.Invoice or Invoice

tools.name: describe_procedure
tools.description: Returns the parameters of one stored procedure (name, type, OUTPUT). Read-only.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists the user tables of the Contoso Billing SQL Server database with their column counts. Use before writing SQL or a repository method. Read-only; returns schema, never row data.
